walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the Edexcel GCSE Computer Science specification.

Computational Thinking appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Computational Thinking in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The Edexcel board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Computational Thinking.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
